# Persistent routine metadata, as BigQuery answers. Project IDs are normalized to PROJECT.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/information-schema-routines
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/information-schema-parameters

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.metadata_explicit_f(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 1) OPTIONS(description = 'explicit result');
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT specific_catalog, specific_schema, specific_name, routine_catalog, routine_schema, routine_name, routine_type, data_type, routine_body, routine_definition, external_language, is_deterministic, security_type, ddl, connection FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES WHERE routine_name = 'metadata_explicit_f')), CONCAT('`', @@project_id, '`'), 'PROJECT'), @@project_id, 'PROJECT')
=> "[{\"specific_catalog\":\"PROJECT\",\"specific_schema\":\"scalars\",\"specific_name\":\"metadata_explicit_f\",\"routine_catalog\":\"PROJECT\",\"routine_schema\":\"scalars\",\"routine_name\":\"metadata_explicit_f\",\"routine_type\":\"FUNCTION\",\"data_type\":\"INT64\",\"routine_body\":\"SQL\",\"routine_definition\":\"x + 1\",\"external_language\":null,\"is_deterministic\":null,\"security_type\":null,\"ddl\":\"CREATE FUNCTION PROJECT.scalars.metadata_explicit_f(x INT64) RETURNS INT64\\nOPTIONS(\\n  description=\\\"explicit result\\\")\\nAS (\\nx + 1\\n);\",\"connection\":null}]"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.metadata_inferred_f(x INT64) AS (x + 1);
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT routine_name, data_type, routine_definition, ddl FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES WHERE routine_name = 'metadata_inferred_f')), CONCAT('`', @@project_id, '`'), 'PROJECT'), @@project_id, 'PROJECT')
=> "[{\"routine_name\":\"metadata_inferred_f\",\"data_type\":null,\"routine_definition\":\"x + 1\",\"ddl\":\"CREATE FUNCTION PROJECT.scalars.metadata_inferred_f(x INT64)\\nAS (\\nx + 1\\n);\"}]"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.metadata_templated_f(x ANY TYPE) AS (x);
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT routine_name, data_type, routine_definition, ddl FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES WHERE routine_name = 'metadata_templated_f')), CONCAT('`', @@project_id, '`'), 'PROJECT'), @@project_id, 'PROJECT')
=> "[{\"routine_name\":\"metadata_templated_f\",\"data_type\":null,\"routine_definition\":\"x\",\"ddl\":\"CREATE FUNCTION PROJECT.scalars.metadata_templated_f(x ANY TYPE)\\nAS (\\nx\\n);\"}]"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.metadata_parameter_explicit(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 1);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.metadata_parameter_inferred(x INT64) AS (x + 1);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.metadata_parameter_templated(x ANY TYPE) AS (x);
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS WHERE specific_name IN ('metadata_parameter_explicit', 'metadata_parameter_inferred', 'metadata_parameter_templated') ORDER BY specific_name, ordinal_position)), CONCAT('`', @@project_id, '`'), 'PROJECT'), @@project_id, 'PROJECT')
=> "[{\"specific_catalog\":\"PROJECT\",\"specific_schema\":\"scalars\",\"specific_name\":\"metadata_parameter_explicit\",\"ordinal_position\":0,\"parameter_mode\":null,\"is_result\":\"YES\",\"parameter_name\":null,\"data_type\":\"INT64\",\"parameter_default\":null,\"is_aggregate\":null},{\"specific_catalog\":\"PROJECT\",\"specific_schema\":\"scalars\",\"specific_name\":\"metadata_parameter_explicit\",\"ordinal_position\":1,\"parameter_mode\":null,\"is_result\":\"NO\",\"parameter_name\":\"x\",\"data_type\":\"INT64\",\"parameter_default\":null,\"is_aggregate\":null},{\"specific_catalog\":\"PROJECT\",\"specific_schema\":\"scalars\",\"specific_name\":\"metadata_parameter_inferred\",\"ordinal_position\":1,\"parameter_mode\":null,\"is_result\":\"NO\",\"parameter_name\":\"x\",\"data_type\":\"INT64\",\"parameter_default\":null,\"is_aggregate\":null},{\"specific_catalog\":\"PROJECT\",\"specific_schema\":\"scalars\",\"specific_name\":\"metadata_parameter_templated\",\"ordinal_position\":1,\"parameter_mode\":null,\"is_result\":\"NO\",\"parameter_name\":\"x\",\"data_type\":\"ANY TYPE\",\"parameter_default\":null,\"is_aggregate\":null}]"

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE scalars.p(IN x INT64) OPTIONS(strict_mode = FALSE, description = 'procedure') BEGIN SELECT x; END;
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT routine_name, routine_type, data_type, routine_body, routine_definition, is_deterministic, security_type, ddl FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES WHERE routine_name = 'p')), CONCAT('`', @@project_id, '`'), 'PROJECT'), @@project_id, 'PROJECT')
=> "[{\"routine_name\":\"p\",\"routine_type\":\"PROCEDURE\",\"data_type\":null,\"routine_body\":\"SQL\",\"routine_definition\":\"BEGIN SELECT x; END\",\"is_deterministic\":null,\"security_type\":null,\"ddl\":\"CREATE PROCEDURE PROJECT.scalars.p(IN x INT64)\\nOPTIONS(\\n  description=\\\"procedure\\\",\\n  strict_mode=false)\\nBEGIN SELECT x; END;\"}]"

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE scalars.parameter_p(IN x INT64) OPTIONS(strict_mode = FALSE) BEGIN SELECT x; END;
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS WHERE specific_name = 'parameter_p' ORDER BY ordinal_position)), CONCAT('`', @@project_id, '`'), 'PROJECT'), @@project_id, 'PROJECT')
=> "[{\"specific_catalog\":\"PROJECT\",\"specific_schema\":\"scalars\",\"specific_name\":\"parameter_p\",\"ordinal_position\":1,\"parameter_mode\":\"IN\",\"is_result\":\"NO\",\"parameter_name\":\"x\",\"data_type\":\"INT64\",\"parameter_default\":null,\"is_aggregate\":null}]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION scalars.metadata_tvf(x INT64) AS (SELECT x AS y);
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT routine_name, routine_type, data_type, routine_body, routine_definition, ddl FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES WHERE routine_name = 'metadata_tvf')), CONCAT('`', @@project_id, '`'), 'PROJECT'), @@project_id, 'PROJECT')
=> "[{\"routine_name\":\"metadata_tvf\",\"routine_type\":\"TABLE FUNCTION\",\"data_type\":null,\"routine_body\":\"SQL\",\"routine_definition\":\"SELECT x AS y\",\"ddl\":\"CREATE TABLE FUNCTION PROJECT.scalars.metadata_tvf(x INT64)\\nAS\\nSELECT x AS y;\"}]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION scalars.metadata_parameter_tvf(x INT64) AS (SELECT x AS y);
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS WHERE specific_name = 'metadata_parameter_tvf' ORDER BY ordinal_position)), CONCAT('`', @@project_id, '`'), 'PROJECT'), @@project_id, 'PROJECT')
=> "[{\"specific_catalog\":\"PROJECT\",\"specific_schema\":\"scalars\",\"specific_name\":\"metadata_parameter_tvf\",\"ordinal_position\":1,\"parameter_mode\":null,\"is_result\":\"NO\",\"parameter_name\":\"x\",\"data_type\":\"INT64\",\"parameter_default\":null,\"is_aggregate\":null}]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION scalars.metadata_explicit_result(x INT64) RETURNS TABLE<y FLOAT64> AS (SELECT x AS y);
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT routine_name, data_type, ddl FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES WHERE routine_name = 'metadata_explicit_result')), CONCAT('`', @@project_id, '`'), 'PROJECT'), @@project_id, 'PROJECT')
=> "[{\"routine_name\":\"metadata_explicit_result\",\"data_type\":\"TABLE<y FLOAT64>\",\"ddl\":\"CREATE TABLE FUNCTION PROJECT.scalars.metadata_explicit_result(x INT64) RETURNS TABLE<y FLOAT64>\\nAS\\nSELECT x AS y;\"}]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION scalars.metadata_result_parameters(x INT64) RETURNS TABLE<y FLOAT64> AS (SELECT x AS y);
SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT * FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARAMETERS WHERE specific_name = 'metadata_result_parameters' ORDER BY ordinal_position)), CONCAT('`', @@project_id, '`'), 'PROJECT'), @@project_id, 'PROJECT')
=> "[{\"specific_catalog\":\"PROJECT\",\"specific_schema\":\"scalars\",\"specific_name\":\"metadata_result_parameters\",\"ordinal_position\":1,\"parameter_mode\":null,\"is_result\":\"NO\",\"parameter_name\":\"x\",\"data_type\":\"INT64\",\"parameter_default\":null,\"is_aggregate\":null}]"
